1 · The definition
What is this pizza?
In English: Super Topping Tropical Seafood Pizza with Pepper Sauce.
Lots of seafood, sweet pineapple and black pepper sauce. Sweet, salty and a little spicy!

3 · The preparation
Get everything ready
1
Make the dough
Mix flour, yeast, salt, sugar, water and oil. Knead for 10 minutes.
2
Let it rise
Cover the dough. Wait 1 hour until it is twice as big.
3
Prep the seafood
Peel the shrimp. Slice the squid into rings.
4
Make the sauce
Melt butter, fry garlic, then add black pepper and oyster sauce.
💪 Tip: Kneading dough = a free arm workout!
English Club Vietnam | Super Topping Seafood Pizza
4 / 12
4 · The cooking
Six easy steps
1
Preheat the oven to 230°C.
2
Roll out the dough into a big circle.
3
Spread the pepper sauce on the dough.
4
Add the seafood, pineapple, bell pepper and onion.
5
Sprinkle cheese on top. A LOT of cheese!
6
Bake for 12–15 minutes until the cheese is golden.
⏱️ Watch the oven! Cheese goes from golden to black very fast 😱
English Club Vietnam | Super Topping Seafood Pizza

5 · The serving
Cut it into 8 slices and share
Wait 2 minutes before you eat. Hot cheese bites back!
Let’s eat! 🍕
